main.description: Record a demand-side observation (ADR 2605011300, ∇φ axis). Trace sources: (1) inbound XRPC 4xx for unknown NSID, (2) Gmail/Teams classifier T3 gray drop (ADR-0032), (3) FraudSignal duplicate detection (yabai). Feeds mv_market_vacuum_score daily aggregation.

lane.description: Inferred or explicit market lane the demand maps to

demandHash.description: SHA-256 of (requester, requested-capability) — never raw PII (ADR-0018 Tier 1 only)

magnitude.description: Weight of this observation (defaults to 1.0; FraudSignal duplicates may carry higher magnitude)

vacuumScoreDelta.description: Per-lane daily ∇φ change after this observation
